category_title: Students at risk of educational failure with significant instructional and behavioral disengagement
minimal_context: The student is working one-on-one with the teacher to transcribe letters to upper-case on a worksheet using an alphabet table.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Let's transcribe these letters to upper-case on your worksheet. Start with the letter 'i'.

STUDENT: (Writes the upper-case 'I' and adds the top and bottom serifs, as shown in the alphabet table.)

TUTOR: Okay. Now let's do the upper-case 'N'. Write it here.

STUDENT: (Makes an incorrect first attempt at the upper-case 'N', then grimaces and looks at the teacher as she erases the letter.)

TUTOR: (Points to the lower-case 't' and locates it in the alphabet table) This is a 't'. Which letter are you going to write?

STUDENT: (Points to the upper-case 'T') I don't know how to write it.

options.A: Ask the student the name of the letter, prompting: 'This one, you know it, it's in your name.'
options.B: Provide a digital app for letter transcription that offers instant rewards with audio and text.
options.C: Give real-life examples of the letter's usage, looking for experiential responses from the student.
options.D: Incorporate regular water and activity breaks to provide short bursts of learning-related activity.
